### ECDF of %tet+ of cloned TCR
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

data <- read_excel("61_TCR_tet_coculture_BFP.xlsx") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(TCR), ~factor(.x, levels = level_TCR)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(phase), ~factor(.x, levels = c("Priming", "Primary", "Recall"))) %>%  
  arrange(TCR) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(bond_type = if_else(bond == "catch", 0, 1)) 

pdata <- data %>% dplyr::filter(phase %in% c("Primary", "Recall", "Priming")) %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(phase), as.character)

# Primary vs Recall  
sample1 <- data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == "Primary") %>% pull(prop_CD69)
sample2 <- data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == "Recall") %>% pull(prop_CD69)
ks_test_p_primary_recall <- ks.test(sample1, sample2, alternative = "less")$p.value
ks_test_d_primary_recall <- ks.test(sample1, sample2, alternative = "less")$statistic

# Primary vs Priming
sample1 <- data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == "Primary") %>% pull(prop_CD69)
sample2 <- data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == "Priming") %>% pull(prop_CD69)
ks_test_p_primary_priming <- ks.test(sample1, sample2, alternative = "less")$p.value
ks_test_d_primary_priming <- ks.test(sample1, sample2, alternative = "less")$statistic

# Recall vs Priming
sample1 <- data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == "Recall") %>% pull(prop_CD69)
sample2 <- data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == "Priming") %>% pull(prop_CD69)
ks_test_p_recall_priming <- ks.test(sample1, sample2, alternative = "less")$p.value
ks_test_d_recall_priming <- ks.test(sample1, sample2, alternative = "less")$statistic
  
print(paste0("Primary vs Recall: KS test D = ", ks_test_d_primary_recall))  
print(paste0("Primary vs Recall: KS test p = ", ks_test_p_primary_recall))  
print(paste0("Primary vs Priming: KS test D = ", ks_test_d_primary_priming))  
print(paste0("Primary vs Priming: KS test p = ", ks_test_p_primary_priming))  
print(paste0("Recall vs Priming: KS test D = ", ks_test_d_recall_priming))  
print(paste0("Recall vs Priming: KS test p = ", ks_test_p_recall_priming))  
  
ggplot(pdata, aes(x = prop_CD69, fill = phase)) + 
  stat_ecdf(aes(color = phase), geom = "smooth", se = FALSE, size=1) + 
  stat_ecdf(geom = "point", size = 2, shape = 21, pad = FALSE) + 
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_phase) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_phase) +
  ylab("ECDF") +
  xlab("Mean % Tet") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  coord_fixed(100)
```




### Compare affinity and %CD69 of low-affinity and high-affinity clones
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=6}

pdata <- data %>% dplyr::filter(TCR %in% c("251", "244", "247", "243", "256", 
  "217", "259", "252", "257", "249", "253", "218", "222", "246", 
  "248", "240", "242", "241", "255", "239", "254", "258", "245", 
  "219", "260", "250")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(tet_prop_25 = if_else(mean_prop > 25, ">25", "<=25")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(x = if_else(tet_prop_25 == "<=25", 1, 2))
plist <- list()
for (metric in c("mean_prop", "log_MFI", "prop_CD69")) {
  cb <- combn(unique(pdata$tet_prop_25),2)
  df_sig <- lapply(1:ncol(cb), function (i){
    conc_1 <- cb[1, i]
    conc_2 <- cb[2, i]
    df_sub <- pdata %>% dplyr::filter(tet_prop_25 %in% c(conc_1, conc_2))
    t1 <- t.test(x = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(tet_prop_25 == conc_1) %>% pull(!!metric),
                 y = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(tet_prop_25 == conc_2) %>% pull(!!metric), 
                 # alternative = "less",
                 var.equal = var_equal)
    c1 <- tibble(p = t1$p.value,
                 xmin = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(tet_prop_25 == conc_1) %>% pull(x) %>% unique(),
                 xmax = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(tet_prop_25 == conc_2) %>% pull(x) %>% unique(),
                 y = max(pdata[[metric]]) - (max(pdata[[metric]])-min(pdata[[metric]]))*0.1,
                 group_1 = conc_1,
                 group_2 = conc_2)
    c1
  }) %>% Reduce("rbind", .)
  df_sig <- df_sig %>% 
    mutate_at(vars(p), scales::number, accuracy = 0.000001)
  
  
  p <- ggplot(pdata, aes(x = x, y = !!sym(metric))) + 
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = x), show.legend = FALSE, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(fill = TCR, shape = bond), size = 2, show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.2) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(slip = 21, catch = 23)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_TCR) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) 
  p <- p + guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
    geom_segment(data = df_sig, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y)) +
    geom_text(data = df_sig, aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = y, label = p), size = 2.5, vjust = -0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:2, labels = c("<=25", ">25")) +
    xlab(NULL)
  plist[[metric]] <- p
}
wrap_plots(plist, nrow = 1)

```

### Scatterplot: %CD69+ vs lifetime_10pN
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}

  theme_bw() +
```

### Compare tetMFI and %CD69 of catch and slip clones
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=3, fig.width=5}

data <- data %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(x = if_else(bond == "catch", 1, 2))

plist <- list()
for (metric in c("log_MFI", "prop_CD69")) {
  
  cb <- combn(unique(data$bond),2)
  df_sig <- lapply(1:ncol(cb), function (i){
    conc_1 <- cb[1, i]
    conc_2 <- cb[2, i]
    df_sub <- data %>% dplyr::filter(bond %in% c(conc_1, conc_2)) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(x = if_else(bond == "catch", 1, 2))
    t1 <- t.test(x = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(bond == conc_1) %>% pull(!!metric),
                 y = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(bond == conc_2) %>% pull(!!metric), 
                 # alternative = "less",
                 var.equal = var_equal)
    c1 <- tibble(p = t1$p.value,
                 xmin = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(bond == conc_1) %>% pull(x) %>% unique(),
                 xmax = df_sub %>% dplyr::filter(bond == conc_2) %>% pull(x) %>% unique(),
                 y = max(data[[metric]])/10*(10+0.6*i),
                 group_1 = conc_1,
                 group_2 = conc_2)
    c1
  }) %>% Reduce("rbind", .)
  df_sig <- df_sig %>% 
    mutate_at(vars(p), scales::number, accuracy = 0.000001)
  
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = !!sym(metric))) + 
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = x), show.legend = FALSE, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(fill = TCR, shape = bond), size = 2, show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.2) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(slip = 21, catch = 23)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_TCR) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
    geom_segment(data = df_sig, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y)) +
    geom_text(data = df_sig, aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = y, label = p), size = 2.5, vjust = -0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:2, labels = c("catch", "slip")) +
    xlab(NULL)
  plist[[metric]] <- p
}
wrap_plots(plist, nrow = 1)


```
